models.name: donor__projects
models.description: Each record represents a donor project.

columns.name: school_city
columns.description: The city where the school is located.

columns.name: school_id
columns.description: Unique identifier for the school where the teacher who created a project works.

columns.name: percentage_lacking_amount_total
columns.description: The percentage of the total amount that is lacking for the project, including the optional price of the project. Leave NULL if the project cost including optional tip is 0.

columns.name: total_price_of_resources
columns.description: The total price of the resources needed for the project, replace NULL values with 0.

columns.name: has_resources_provided_by_LLM
columns.description: Set to 1 if the project has resources provided by 'Lakeshore Learning Materials', otherwise, set to 0

columns.name: item_cost_most
columns.description: The item with the most cost in the project, with ties broken by the ascending order of the item name

columns.name: avg_amount_donation
columns.description: The average amount of donation for the project, excluding optional support (tip).
